source.document: monday.com Ltd. Form 6-K, Exhibit 99.1 press release "monday.com Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results" (accession 0001178913-26-005085, filed November 9, 2026)

notes: Non-GAAP operating income was $89.4M, $16.6M above the top of the call's $62.9M to $72.8M range: non-GAAP R&D, sales and marketing, and G&A spending were all lower than the plan assumed, R&D by the most ($70.0M against $84.1M).
Adjusted free cash flow had no call. Restructuring payments in the quarter were $47.2M, against the $16.25M of severance cash the plan assumed.
